Hey, I'm Igor 👋

Founder & engineer at RioBlocks · Lead Engineer at MemPalace · Blockchain infrastructure at EOS Rio

I build developer tools, AI infrastructure, and low-level systems. My work spans data engines, networking, applications for working with AI agents, and blockchain infrastructure.

I work across TypeScript, Rust, Zig, and Python, choosing the tools that fit the problem.

This card is powered by MyRank.dev, a developer profiles and rankings platform I built.

Things I build

  • MyRank.dev — Developer profiles and rankings built from verified commit history.
  • AfterPic — AI-powered photo editor.
  • WormDB — An embeddable key-value engine in Zig, with write-once records, native stored procedures, and vector search.
  • Agent Portal — A desktop app for browsing and migrating sessions between coding agents, built with Rust, Tauri, and Angular.
  • ShellPort — A browser-based remote terminal in a single binary, with its own Canvas2D terminal emulator.
  • Meshrooms — Shared rooms for people and their agents, bringing conversations, tasks, files, and decisions together. Currently in beta.

Developer tools & libraries

  • meshguard — A peer-to-peer, WireGuard-compatible mesh VPN daemon in Zig, with no central coordinator.
  • context-builder — A Rust CLI for assembling codebase context for LLM prompts.
  • universal-llm-client — A TypeScript client for working with multiple LLM providers through one interface.
  • comfyui-node — A fully typed Node.js client for programmatic ComfyUI control.
  • Angular Translation Service — Signal-based i18n with runtime language switching, SSR support, and a companion CLI.
  • FontAwesome MCP — An independent MCP server for finding icons and retrieving SVGs and integration guidance.

MemPalace

I'm the lead developer and a project maintainer at MemPalace, an open-source AI memory system.

My work spans core development, ingestion reliability, data preservation, retrieval quality, performance, and security, alongside reviewing contributions and maintaining the codebase.

Open-source contributions

  • llmman (formerly inferrs) — My contributions during the inferrs era include Ollama API compatibility for thinking mode and duration metrics, plus a CUDA static-linking fix.

I've also contributed upstream fixes to uWebSockets.js, Engine.IO, Angular Font Awesome, and Abieos.

Blockchain infrastructure at EOS Rio

Over the years, I've worked on infrastructure and tooling for Antelope-based blockchains with the EOS Rio team.

  • Hyperion — Full-history API and indexer, alongside its explorer and streaming client.
  • fleet-router — A Rust reverse proxy and load balancer for Antelope SHiP, with range-aware routing and failover.
  • hyperion-tools — Rust tooling for state-history decoding, snapshot ingestion, and log recovery, including experimental components.
  • SimplEOS — A desktop wallet for the Antelope ecosystem.
  • node-abieos and rs-abieos — Node.js and Rust bindings for Abieos.
  • bp-info-standard — A standard for block producer metadata.
